Class ItemOps

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.util.ItemOps
public final class ItemOps extends Object
Item handling shared by all three stack types: what a hand can accept, how a taken stack reaches the player, how a broken block sheds its contents, and how stored items add up to a light level.

    • canTakeIntoHand

      public static boolean canTakeIntoHand(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack hand, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack offer)
      Whether an extraction may land in this hand: it must be empty, or hold the same item and data components with room left. This keeps a player's hand from being swapped out mid-gesture.

    • mergeIntoStack

      public static int mergeIntoStack(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack hand, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack incoming)
      Moves as much of incoming into hand as it will hold, growing the hand in place. The caller shrinks the source by the amount reported.
      Returns:
      how many items moved, zero when the two do not stack
